Hello from a slightly chalky office in Cork! We're Brackenhold, a small team of climbers who got fed up scribbling hangboard sessions on the backs of gym receipts, so we built an app for it. It gives you a week-by-week training plan (fingerboard, bouldering, ropes), times your hangs and logs every session so you can see yourself getting stronger.

Late summer is our big moment. Students are heading back to uni and rejoining their climbing clubs, and loads of people who drifted off over the summer want a proper plan for the autumn. So we'd love a back-to-school push.

The basics:
- The campaign runs from Friday, July 30, 2027 through Tuesday, August 10, 2027, on Dublin time (Irish time).
- What we care about is free-trial starts. We count trial starts, and the goal is as many of them as possible.
- Send people to https://brackenhold.ie/trial
- We don't have X's pixel on the site, so X won't see the trial starts. We track them on our side.
- The app exists only on iPhone and Android phones, and it's only available in Ireland and the United Kingdom.

Here's the copy from our landing page:
"Brackenhold is the climbing training app that builds you a week-by-week plan for fingerboarding, bouldering and rope sessions, with built-in hang timers and a log of every session. Start with a 14-day free trial, then it's €8.99 a month in Ireland or £7.99 a month in the United Kingdom, and you can cancel anytime. Brackenhold is available to climbers in Ireland and the United Kingdom, on iPhone and Android phones only."

You're free to launch and run the campaign yourself. No need to check with us before making changes. Please keep an eye on it for the whole flight, and when it wraps up, send us a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks. Thanks a million, and go raibh maith agat!

Total budget: 400.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 4 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:

payload.text:
Go raibh maith agaibh — your back-to-school campaign has wrapped up.

**What I launched**

- **Campaign:** Brackenhold Back to School 2027 (`vwtdh`)
- **Ad group:** Back to School - IE & UK - Phones - Trial (`41b3c`)
- **Flight:** Friday, July 30, 2027, 00:00 Dublin time (`2027-07-29T23:00:00Z`) through Tuesday, August 10, 2027, 23:59 Dublin time (`2027-08-10T23:00:00Z`)
- **Objective:** `WEBSITE_CLICKS` with `LINK_CLICKS` optimization
  - I did not use `WEBSITE_CONVERSIONS`, because you do not have X's pixel installed, so X cannot observe free-trial starts.
- **Budget:** $33.33 daily, with a $400.00 total cap (`400000000` micro) on the line item
- **Targeting:**
  - Ireland (`ea679934779f45c7`)
  - United Kingdom (`6416b8512febefc9`)
  - iOS (`0`)
  - Android (`1`)
- **Placement:** `ALL_ON_TWITTER`
- **Promoted posts:** All four approved posts, and no new posts:
  - `2214148860933722322`
  - `2214330054866267849`
  - `2214511248799313528`
  - `2214692442733464310`

All four posts were accepted, and both the campaign and ad group were activated for the flight.

**Final recap**

- **Spend:** $389.19 of the $400.00 budget
- **Impressions:** 407,654
- **Link clicks:** 218
- **Cost per link click:** Approximately $1.79

Free-trial starts are not included because, without X's pixel on https://brackenhold.ie/trial, X cannot attribute or report them. Those should be measured in your own tracking.
